text:
devon_oncall: paging — p99 spike and streaming stalls seen since 12:04 UTC, users hitting higher tail on text-generation routes, large # of 504s on streaming. noticing router->egress LB misrouting in the traces. paging SREs @alex_sre and runtime @maria_runtime :eyes:
incidentbot: [ALERT] Path: /v1/generate — p95 420ms -> 1.8s, p99 1.2s -> 6.3s, error rate 0.7% (streaming timeouts). Incident priority: P1. Page sent to on-call.
devon_oncall: initial observation — overall throughput fine, but tail concentrated on a small set of LB backends in eu-west2, router hash distribution shows hot partition on shard 17. streaming stalls correlate to requests routed to those backends.
alex_sre: pulling heatmap now — grafana/dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/egress-heatmap?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west2
maria_runtime: grabbing traces. root cause candidate: routing affinity weights for routed-model-v2 drifted after recent rollout, sticky affinity bumped a few zones and didn't respect fallback. leads to hot keys packing to same egress LB -> KV cache churn and per-token tail.
jamie_cs: customers flagging partial outages — tenant:atomic-ai reported 30% stream failures, sent outbound email. Need ETA for mitigation to share.
alex_sre: running quick queries: 
```
# count requests per egress node in last 5m
select node, count(*) from ingress.requests where route='/v1/generate' and region='eu-west2' group by node order by count desc limit 10;
```
results: node-eu-17 = 42k, node-eu-03 = 1.2k, node-eu-09 = 900. massive skew.
ops_lead: probable bug in routing policy evaluation after weights change — saw negative weight normalization in controller logs around 12:01. Posting controller logs: 
```
controller | WARN | normalizeWeights() negative delta for route routed-model-v2 weights=[0.0,0.8,-0.3,0.5]
```
devon_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) remove affinity override for routed-model-v2 in eu-west2 (force uniform hash), 2) drain node-eu-17 from LB pool, 3) fallback to smaller model variant for streaming-heavy routes until stable. execute in that order.
maria_runtime: running command to clear affinity overrides: `infractl routing update --route routed-model-v2 --region eu-west2 --affinity none --dry-run=false`
incidentbot: command executed by maria_runtime at 1769123490. Confirmed rollout event to routers.
alex_sre: starting graceful drain of node-eu-17: `lbctl remove-backend node-eu-17 --grace-period=30s`
eng_runtime_bot: drain started for node-eu-17 (drain id drn-7853). Current connections will complete; new connections steered away.
jamie_cs: telling Atomic AI support: "we see elevated streaming failures; we've identified misrouting causing hot backend overload and are draining the node now. Mitigation in progress, ETA ~5-10m for stable streams."
ops_lead: monitor p99 and streaming timeouts; if not improving in 7m, shift traffic to dedicated pool `dedicated-low-latency` for affected tenants.
alex_sre: p95/p99 trending: 1m after drain p95 -> 260ms (was 420ms), p99 -> 1.1s (was 6.3s). streaming timeouts down 60%. good signal.
maria_runtime: checking KV cache metrics — miss rate on router cache for shard 17 dropped from 78% -> 12% after affinity removal. confirms hot key packing was thrashing KV caches.
devon_oncall: handoff: I'm going to step off primary but staying reachable. @alex_sre you're primary for mitigation / postmortem. @maria_runtime continue runtime follow-ups.
alex_sre: acknowledged. I'll own the follow-up and blameless postmortem. Posting temporary incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INCIDENT-4421 (create notes).
incidentbot: Note: Affected tenants detected: ["atomic-ai","novum-ops","chatwise-pro"]. Severity impact: degraded streaming for 3 tenants, transient 504s for broader sample.
jamie_cs: drafting customer outreach: "We mitigated routing imbalance by removing a misapplied affinity override and draining the overloaded backend. We're investigating why the controller normalized weights incorrectly and will follow up with RCA."
ops_lead: quick root cause hypothesis: controller weight normalization bug allowed negative weight to persist which skewed hash -> pack. Remedy: add validation to controller API to reject negative/invalid weights and a periodic rebalancer to detect hot backends.
maria_runtime: runtime tweak suggestion: add short-lived fallback routing that bypasses affinity if any LB node exceeds 65% of regional RPS for >30s. Could be a safety net while we fix controller.
alex_sre: created follow-up tasks: INC-4422 add controller validation, INC-4423 implement rebalancer alert, INC-4424 add ephemeral fallback policy.
devon_oncall: monitoring 15m window. No further customer escalations. I'll mark incident P1->P2 in 30min if stable.
alex_sre: final status update for channel: "Mitigation applied: affinity override removed, overloaded backend drained, p99 and streaming errors trending down. Customers notified. Investigations ongoing for controller weight normalization. Owning follow-up action items." :white_check_mark:
eng_runtime_bot: automated snapshot of relevant metrics attached to incident ticket INC-4421. (logs, traces, heatmap)
jamie_cs: sending updated customer note.
devon_oncall: leaving thread to alex_sre. If anything regresses alert me.
alex_sre: will run post-incident eval, include prompt set regression tests to ensure streaming paths maintain tail SLO. thanks all for fast responses.
incidentbot: incident status changed: Mitigated at 1769123720, Monitoring. Closing notes to be added to INC-4421."
